note: Inbound Shipments list with the filter row (Supplier Id, Status, Expected From/To, Apply, Reset, Refresh, + Create Inbound) and the shipment table.
Receiving QC Queue with the queue/Quarantine toggle, Scan SKU / Lot and Reason Code fields and Pass / Fail buttons.
Putaway Tasks table (Tasks from RECEIVING) with the To Location selector and the Putaway button.
Sales Orders list with status/customer/date filters and the + Create button.
Outbound Orders list with filters, status badges and Pack button on PICKED rows.
Dispatch Confirmation list of packed shipments with the Dispatch button.
Wave Picking page with the Create Wave card and the Active Waves table.
Picking Tasks page: Create Task card on the left, Locations + Complete Task card on the right.
Labels Station: Print / Preview card (template, JSON data) and the Queue table.
Cross-Dock Tracking: Create Cross-Dock Match card and the Cross-Dock Queue with Match / Complete buttons.
Returns / RMA: Create RMA card and the RMA Queue with Receive / Restock / Scrap buttons.
Stock Transfers list with the status filter, + Create Transfer and Submit / Approve / Execute buttons.
Cycle Counts list with Schedule Cycle Count button and View / Execute / Review Discrepancies buttons.
Schedule Cycle Count form: date, ABC class, operator and the location checkboxes.
Stock Adjustments: Create Adjustment form and the Adjustment History table. Needs WarehouseManager or WarehouseAdmin.
Available Stock after a search by SKU (table view with Physical / Reserved / Available columns).
Stock Dashboard: filter row, four summary tiles, Stock by Location and Low Stock Alerts blocks.
Reservations list with the status filter, Start Picking / Pick buttons.

Partijų sąrašas (Admin > Lots): paieškos laukas, būsenos pasirinkimas, mygtukai Filter ir Refresh, lentelė su stulpeliais Lot, Item, Qty, Cost, Sale, Value, Reserved, Available, UoM, Production, Expiry, Status.

Serijų numerių ekranas: blokas Register Serial, paieškos eilutė (Serial, Item ID, Status, Location, Search, Reset) ir lentelė. Jei paskyra be admin rolės, rodomas tik pranešimas 'Admin role required.' - tada reikia admin paskyros.
Sandėlio žemėlapis 2D vaizdu: įrankių juosta (sandėlio pasirinkimas, paieška, 3D/2D perjungiklis, Filters), SVG planas su vietomis ir spalvų legenda Status.
Sandėlio žemėlapis 3D vaizdu: matoma 3D scena su lentynomis, legenda ir blokas 'Mouse controls'. Reikia WebGL palaikymo; jei scena tuščia, šį paveikslėlį praleisti.

Atsargų likučių ataskaita (Stock Level Report): filtrų eilutė su Item ID, Location Id, Category Id, Expiring Before, varnelėmis Include reserved ir Include virtual, mygtukais Apply ir Export CSV; lentelė su likučiais.
Atsargų judėjimų ataskaita (Stock Movement History): datų laukai Start ir End (paskutinės 7 dienos), Movement Type sąrašas, mygtukai Apply ir CSV, lentelė su judėjimais.

Partijos kelio ataskaita (Traceability report (Lot -> Order)): filtrai Lot Number, Item SKU, Sales Order, Supplier, mygtukai Search ir Reset; partijų kortelės su blokais Upstream, Current, Downstream Sales ir ženkleliu Approximate Linkage.

Atitikties skydelis: trys skaičių kortelės (Pending Exports, Recent Lot Traces, Variance Alerts), forma Schedule Report, lentelė Recent Scheduled Reports ir lentelė Scheduled Jobs. Reikia WarehouseManager arba Auditor paskyros.
Fulfillment KPIs: keturios kortelės (Total Orders, Shipped Orders, On-Time Delivery, Avg Pick Minutes) ir lentelė 14-Day Trend.
Kokybės analitika: kortelės QC Defect Count ir Late Shipments, lentelės Top Defect Types ir Late Shipments.

Sandėlio pradžios skydelis (Warehouse Dashboard): sandėlių perjungiklis, KPI kortelės, žiedinė diagrama, sandėlių stulpeliai, Low stock & reorder, Expiring soon, Incoming & expected, Agnum integration health, Reservations & picking, Recent activity.

Projekcijų ekranas: lentelė Projection Lag, blokas Rebuild / Verify su projekcijos pasirinkimu ir mygtukais Rebuild bei Verify, blokas Warehouse consolidation ir Runbook. Nespausti Rebuild, Verify ar Move stock.
Warehouse Settings form: Capacity Threshold, Default Pick Strategy, Low Stock Threshold, Reorder Point, Auto allocate orders, Save button.
Reason Codes list with Category/Active filters and the Add Reason Code button.
Create User form on the left and the Users table with Edit buttons on the right.
API Keys list with the Create New Key form open (name, rate limit, expiry, scopes). Do not press Save.
Security Audit Logs with filters (User, Action, Resource, Start, End, Fetch Limit) and the results table.
GDPR Erasure Requests: New Erasure Request form and the request list with Approve/Reject buttons.
Items Management grid with search, category and status filters and the Create button.
Warehouses Management list with filters and the Create Warehouse button.
Locations Management list with filters (code/barcode, status, placement warehouse) and the Create Location button.
Warehouse Layout Editor: warehouse selector, Layout JSON and Rack Config JSON text areas, Reload and Save Layout buttons. Do not press Save Layout.
Suppliers Management grid with filters, Create, Mappings and Refresh from Agnum buttons. Do not press Refresh from Agnum.
Import Master Data page with the entity tabs, Download Template, File and Dry run controls.
Create Inbound Shipment form: reference, supplier, invoice number/date, currency, net/VAT amounts, VAT treatment, accounting route, lines and additional costs.
Inbound Shipment Detail of the posted PLN document (id 13): Purchase document card with Posted badge, PLN/EUR amounts, Bank of Lithuania rate, VAT treatment, Agnum queue state and Un-post button.
New credit note / return form prefilled from posted shipment id 13 (kind, number, date, VAT, lines table). Do not press Post.
Posted supplier credit id 1 with lines, amounts and Amount sent to Agnum.
Additional cost invoices page: New cost invoice form and the list of cost invoices.
Agnum accounting configuration, tab Stock accounts (default tab) with the profile table.
Agnum accounting configuration, Sending tab: switch, start date, service address, Check connection and queue state.
Agnum sending queue with the status filter, Send now button, queue table and the nightly reconciliation section.
Opening balances page: CSV file picker, Preview and Confirm and load buttons, list of loaded opening documents.

Intrastat arrivals page: Month field with Show, Download CSV and Download XML, the Declarant (VAT payer) block, warnings, the report table with totals and the XML versions of the month list. Reads posted purchase documents; nothing is changed (do not press Download XML, it creates a version). Month defaults to the current one; if it is empty pick the month that has the posted EU purchase document (id 14).
Element shot of the Declarant (VAT payer) block opened: VAT code, name, address, contact person, e-mail, phone and Save. Do not press Save.
Issue to Production page: the form (Item, Qty, From location, Production task / order, Notes, Issue to production) and the journal of the last 30 days. Do not press Issue to production.

Stock by Supplier report for the supplier MegaMarket: supplier field, period, Only shortages, Apply, Export CSV and the table with On hand, To production, Dispatched, Written off, Missing and price columns. Read only.
Items list filtered by the Intrastat data missing checkbox (Filter pressed): rows with the Intrastat missing badge, first row ticked, the Set Intrastat data (1 selected) button.

Set Intrastat data for several items dialog opened for one ticked item: scope choice (selected / all by filter), commodity code, country of origin, supplementary unit and factor, Cancel and Continue. Do not press Continue.
Item Details of item id 1307: the Intrastat block under the main fields with commodity code, net weight, country of origin and supplementary unit (and the Data missing badge when something is empty).

Create Inbound Shipment with VAT treatment set to EU acquisition: the Delivery terms, Transport mode, Country of dispatch and Transaction nature fields are visible. Nothing is saved; never press Create Shipment.
Inbound Shipment Detail of the posted EU purchase document (id 14): Purchase document card with VAT treatment EU acquisition and the Intrastat line (11 / DAP / 3 / PL). Read only.
Month end page for the previous month: state badge, Close month button or blockers, stock value statement.
Valuation Dashboard: summary cards, Revaluation button and Valuation register.
Revaluation of stock form (empty): Item, New unit price (EUR), Approved By, Reason.
